limitations: Initial read-only mount test failed because tests create project temporary files; corrected isolated writable tree passed.
Tests do not prove profitability or a statistical advantage over the market. Complete-context fixtures and short runtime checks do not replace prospective production evaluation.
PG dataset verification measures loading only, not end-to-end training.

Final integration initial full suite and module repeat failed on ctime clock-resolution fixture; deterministic metadata-change fixture corrected, without changing the production verifier. Full suite then passed.
The 1,678-test suite and 119-file mypy check are bound to source-freeze-v3.json; later ledger/UI changes are not covered by those results.
New-generation inputs cover five matches, but qualified settled training cohort is zero; no full production fit duration or successful new-generation model training was measured.
Runtime HTTP 200 responses are short health checks. History statistics have an unresolved slow-query path and are not certified complete.
Cash-budget probes used an isolated PG schema, not real venue submissions; no real-money execution was used as verification.
The 1,716-test v6 source freeze covers implementation and synthetic regression behavior, not model profitability or a new approved production fit.
Reservation PG checks certify isolated backfill/exact release/restart behavior, not native live pagination completeness; final scanner source/refresh observation remains pending.
The earlier read-only production inventory contained unknown3, pending330, sending1, accepted58 and zero backfilled reservations; held_count=0 was not evidence of zero risk.
Production browser v5 failed due to an overly broad diagnostic-timeout assertion; the corrected read-only v6 structural check passed. Failures remain available.
History v3 three-round timings and the 263.66-second production observation do not constitute sustained P95 or four-hour monitoring.
No real-money submission, forced model promotion, configuration change or new profitability result was performed for verification.

Pending-deployment statements in earlier scoped entries are historical. Final deployment_v6 and browser v7 now verify source and refresh availability; the live native sweep remains intentionally unexercised with betting disabled.
